thm:elabstratificationmodp: $\Mod((R/p)^{hE})$
nodes.statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p$, let $A$ be a discrete Noetherian commutative algebra $A \in \mathrm{CAlg}(k)$, and $E \cong (\mathbb{Z}/p)^{\times r}$ an elementary abelian $p$-group of rank $r$. The tt-category $\mathrm{Mod}(A^{hE})$ is stratified over the spectrum
\[
\mathrm{Spc}(\mathrm{Mod}^c(A^{hE})) \cong \mathrm{Spec}^h(\pi_*A^{hE}).
\]

nodes.name: prop:elabeqstratificationcharp: $\Mod_{\Sp_{E}}(\underline{R/p}_E)$
nodes.statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p$, let $A$ be a discrete Noetherian commutative algebra $A \in \mathrm{CAlg}(k)$. If $E$ is an elementary abelian $p$-group, then the tt-category $\mathrm{Mod}_{\mathrm{Sp}_{E}}(\underline{A}_E)$ is stratified over its spectrum
\[
\mathrm{Spc}(\mathrm{Mod}_{\mathrm{Sp}_{E}}^c(\underline{A}_E)) \cong \mathrm{Spec}^h(\pi_*A^{hE}).
\]

nodes.name: thm:elabeqstratification: $\Mod_{\Sp_{E}}(\underline{R}_E)$
nodes.statement:
Let $R$ be a regular commutative ring. If $E$ is an elementary abelian $p$-group, then the tt-category $\mathrm{Mod}_{\mathrm{Sp}_{E}}(\underline{R}_E)$ is stratified over its spectrum
\[
\mathrm{Spc}(\mathrm{Mod}_{\mathrm{Sp}_{E}}^c(\underline{R}_E)) \cong \mathrm{Spec}^h(\pi_*R^{hE}).
\]

nodes.name: thm:repstratification: $\Rep(E,R)$
nodes.statement: Suppose $G$ is a finite group and $R$ is a regular commutative ring, then $\mathrm{Rep}(G,R)$ is stratified over $\mathrm{Spc}(\mathrm{rep}(G,R)) \cong \mathrm{Spec}^h(H^*(G;R))$.
